scope: Read-only full-pointer/full-size metadata + CUDA API request proof. Protected destination clone, expected src/dst CUDA ordinal, shape/stride/type, actual consumer, stable metadata. Logical requests only, not hardware DMA counters or speed attribution. Partial/address-only coincidences excluded.
fallback_note: The raw probe also admits reshaped keep tensors whose ne1 is n_blocks; therefore generation3/4 queries are captured. Classification uses canonical source query width. Tiny fallback copies remain intentionally unchanged.
